adapterBoundary.nativeWrites: JSON and managed byte writes with independent native/host grants, exact single-use preview confirmation, private results and durable journals

discovery.help:
Proxmox managed reads, JSON writes and bounded byte streams. Run each command with --help for selectors and limits.
Writes require both native profile operations and administrator host operation grants, off by default. Use --preview, then repeat identical inputs with --confirm <confirmation>.
The administrator saves an API token (preferred) or username/password; users have no separate Proxmox login. Password tickets are acquired automatically and cached in memory for at most five minutes. TFA accounts require an API token.
Use --protected-input with bounded private stdin {api,secrets}; sensitive values require PVE_INPUT_ env SecretRefs and never arguments or server files.
Protected results are retrieved once through result take <operation> <id> into an inherited private pipe.
Use stream limits, then stream -- transfer|duplex <native arguments> with PROXMOX_AXI_STREAM_FD and a distinct private setup descriptor for duplex. Upload --input-file is local only; previews bind verified source bytes and SHA-256.
Use journal show/reconcile <id> and journal-bound task status/log/wait after uncertainty; never resend a consumed confirmation or reconnect an interrupted write.
